title: rosmarinus officinalis var. serotinus
intro: Rosmarinus officinalis var. serotinus, commonly known as Rock Rose or Rosmarinus serotinus, is a variant of the rosemary plant that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and providing antioxidant protection. The therapeutic actions of Rosmarinus officinalis var. serotinus include acting as a nervine, carminative, and expectorant, which can help to soothe the nervous system, relieve digestive issues, and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include camphor, borneol, and bornyl acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
